title: Cabbage Portal Dragon Dance
description: A circular metallic porthole embedded in giant green cabbage leaves reveals three scantily clad female dancers with white hair performing a ritual with glowing blue energy around a central cabbage. A small green dragon with leafy wings sits in the foreground among skulls and roots against a dark, mystical night sky with purple aurora.
prompt: A circular metal porthole frame is embedded inside a giant green cabbage, showing three white-haired fantasy women in revealing outfits dancing around a central cabbage while casting glowing blue magic. A cute small green dragon with leafy wings sits in the foreground beside skulls and roots. Dark mystical night background with purple aurora and bare branches, surreal fantasy scene.
